notes.title: Major Patch 1 !
notes.content:
Hello, detectives !

Here we are, the 2nd act of The Elliot Brown Case have arrived and has been rendered accessible to all !

Moreover, we at Destiny Card also worked to improve the game experience, the biggest highlight being the graphical overhaul of our Custom Story Tool ! 

[hr][/hr]

Patchnote
Additions :

 Act 2 added.


Bug fixes :

 Cards can no longer spawn under the table when loading a save.
 Group selection visual is now the correct size.
 Fixed group selection visual showing while resizing a Post-It.
 Fixed beeing able to interact with the game while the pause menu was displayed.
 Fixed cards and post-its spawn position on load.
 Fixed progress when uploading custom story to the workshop going from 0 to 1 instead of 0 to 100.
 Fixed card names overlapping when placed in interrogation panel or question panel.


Improvements :

 If the game was saved on a preview Act, the correct Act will be loaded instead.
 The Mind Palace's help window only closes when clicking on the "?".
 Clicking on a card while finishing an interaction won't display the card anymore.
 Improved Mind Palace zoom user experience.
 Examination folder will be highlighted when hovered.
 Creating post it is more consistent.
 Question solved and new day effects won't stack on top of each other.
 Improved Custom Story Editor's graphics. 
 Improved User Experience when loading or creating custom stories.
 Added a button to close the feedback form.
 Improved ui elements when answering the final question.


[hr][/hr]

Do you have any question ? If so, ask them in the Discord, right below this announcement or even in the Community Hub!

Have a good business, detective.

The Destiny Card team

notes.title: Release plans changed !
notes.content:
Hello detectives!

We come with news, so your investigation can progress. But. There is a good news, and a bad news. Let's start with the latter.

The game will solely be publically published upon its full release (not in an early access state) -- the 15th of April.
As you may know, we are students at Rubika Supinfogame. To keep you informed: This delay is there so that our communication channels (especially thanks to the school and its network) are synchronized with the release of our game. It's important so that, as small independents who've never released a game, we can have a chance to make our game a little better known.

BUT
Good news : You will still be able to playtest the game, by joining us on our Discord! 
All you have to do is join our Discord server! Periodically, playtest sessions will be organized to gather feedback on the game, and we hope to stimulate your interest in it. We look forward to hearing from you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881449/fa71970036f12b11cb94bf01f8576cd76633e6dd.png

Do you have any question ? If so, ask them in the Discord or right below this announcement or even in the Community Hub!

Have a good business, detective.

Destiny Card Team



P.S. : If you still see the game being announced for release for the 23rd or the 29th or February, this is due to internal Steam delay.
